bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Unclean shutdown detected. Local cache metadata on /home is out of date and may cause stale reads and elevated CPU wakeups. Running a resync will verify checksums, rebuild the index, and flush dirty pages to disk (EXT4). Estimated time: 2–3 minutes. Code: CACHE-SYNC-0xA3F2. TEST ONLY — simulated notification for security UI stress-testing.
